data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate recorded a significant gross release in prior-year reserves in 2015: gross claims outstanding at 31/12/2014 were GBP 149.101m and the gross movement on prior-year provisions in 2015 was a release of GBP 73.108m (49.1% of opening gross reserves). Management attributes the movement principally to favourable claims development and reserve improvements on prior years, primarily within the International and US Property portfolio. A number of individually named 2015 loss events (e.g. Hurricane Patricia, South Carolina floods) were modest in size relative to the prior-year reserve release.

The technical provisions set at 31 December 2014 have proven to be robust

Favourable movements of GBP 25.4 million, (2014: GBP 17.8 million), in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance.

data.data_quality_notes: Primary prior-year movement sourced from the Technical Provisions reconciliation table (gross change in prior year provisions = (73,108) GBP 000). The report also cites a GBP 14.1m 'improvement on closed years' reserves' (narrative) which appears to be a narrower/alternative measure (likely net or closed-years-only) - the figure used in this JSON is the gross movement from the Technical Provisions table. All monetary amounts in main fields are converted to millions. Claims development triangle provided in the notes is in thousands.
